<p>{ai} puts the answer of a language model in the page. What stands between the tags
renders first - fields, loops, anything - and what it rendered is the prompt; the answer comes back
as text. It is a value, never template code: markup in it is shown, not run, and so is a PAD tag:</p>

          <td style="vertical-align:top"><pre><code style="color: #000000"><span style="color: #0000BB">&lt;?php<br><br>  </span><span style="color: #FF8000">// Anthropic is not asked here: a fake answers in the shape of its Messages API, as a test<br>  // answers it. In an application the key stands in .env as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; here it is<br>  // put where padEnv finds it first.<br><br>  </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$_ENV </span><span style="color: #007700">[</span><span style="color: #DD0000">'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'</span><span style="color: #007700">] = </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'sk-example'</span><span style="color: #007700">;<br><br>  </span><span style="color: #0000BB">padCurlFake </span><span style="color: #007700">( [ </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages' </span><span style="color: #007700">=&gt; [ </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'data' </span><span style="color: #007700">=&gt; [<br>    </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'stop_reason' </span><span style="color: #007700">=&gt; </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'end_turn'</span><span style="color: #007700">,<br>    </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'content'     </span><span style="color: #007700">=&gt; [ [ </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'type' </span><span style="color: #007700">=&gt; </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'text'</span><span style="color: #007700">, </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'text' </span><span style="color: #007700">=&gt; </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'Two friends trade pots of &lt;b&gt;jam&lt;/b&gt; &amp; {stories} across one long winter.' </span><span style="color: #007700">] ] ] ] ] );<br><br>  </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$body </span><span style="color: #007700">= </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'All winter long Ann and Bo swapped jars of jam over the fence, and with every jar a story.'</span><span style="color: #007700">;<br><br></span><span style="color: #0000BB">?&gt;<br></span></code></pre> </td>

<p>The answer is kept: the same provider, model, system prompt and prompt on a later request is the
same answer, no request made - for an hour unless <code>ttl=</code> says otherwise, never with
<code>ttl=0</code>. A failed answer is never kept.</p>

<h2>From PHP</h2>

<p><code>padAi ( $prompt, $options )</code> asks the same from a page's PHP and answers the text - here
Ollama, which runs a model on this machine and needs no key:</p>

[ </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'data' </span><span style="color: #007700">=&gt; [ </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'message' </span><span style="color: #007700">=&gt; [ </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'role' </span><span style="color: #007700">=&gt; <h2>Providers and options</h2>

<p>Every provider is a file of <code>pad/subs/ai/types/</code> - anthropic, bedrock, cloudflare, cohere, gemini, lmstudio, mistral, ollama, openai -
with its endpoint, its headers, the request it builds and how it reads the text and an error out of
the answer. A provider is added by adding its file.</p>

<ul>
  <li><code>provider=</code> names one - else <code>PAD_AI_PROVIDER</code> from <code>.env</code>, else
      anthropic. Its key is a <code>.env</code> value: <code>ANTHROPIC_API_KEY</code>,
      <code>OPENAI_API_KEY</code>, <code>MISTRAL_API_KEY</code>, <code>GEMINI_API_KEY</code>,
      <code>COHERE_API_KEY</code>, <code>CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN</code> (and the account in
      <code>CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID</code>), <code>AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK</code> (and the region in
      <code>AWS_REGION</code>); Ollama's address <code>OLLAMA_HOST</code>, while LM Studio needs no key
      unless it is set up to, <code>LM_API_TOKEN</code> then.</li>
  <li><code>model=</code> the model - claude-opus-5-5 for Anthropic unless given; <code>system=</code> the
      system prompt; <code>tokens=</code> the most the answer may take - the handling option
      <code>max</code> is something else.</li>
  <li>A missing key, an unknown provider or an error of the API - a refused key, a limit, a refusal -
      is an error under the strict check, so it shows while the page is written. Without it the tag
      answers nothing, the page goes on, the error is logged and <code>padAiError ()</code> says it.</li>
  <li>A test answers the provider with <code>padCurlFake</code>, as the examples here do; while the
      fetches are faked no answer is kept.</li>
</ul>
